propositions: code-review-verify produces only {verifications: [...]} output with no decision polarity, causing _verdict_decision to fall through to advisory regardless of gold label
V-real-defect gold-block case is scored as advisory on both standard and frontier arms, creating a guaranteed symmetric recall miss
Naively mapping non-empty verifications list to block would fix the recall miss but simultaneously mis-score V-clean-rename (gold-advisory) as block, creating a false accept
code-review-verify must be excluded from the parity corpus by a separate named mechanism distinct from AGENTIC_SOLVERS to preserve the semantic reason and prevent silent re-admission
Exclusion reduces n_gold from 28 to 26 (still above MIN_GOLD_ITEMS floor of 20) and raises recall without flipping any gating verdicts since the miss was symmetric across arms
